name: Zadun, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
insider_take: Where desert meets sea in the most exclusive corner of Los Cabos, this ultra-luxury sanctuary redefines barefoot elegance.
whats_special: Zadun is the first and only Ritz-Carlton Reserve in Mexico, featuring just 115 suites and villas spread across 37 oceanfront acres. The property sits on the pristine Playa Balandra beach, known for its swimmable waters—a rarity in Cabo. The resort's name means "fast-flowing water" in the indigenous Guaycura language, honoring the region's original inhabitants.
pro_tip: Book the Sea of Cortez Villa for unparalleled privacy—it comes with a dedicated villa host and your own stretch of beach, plus direct access to world-class snorkeling right from your doorstep.
dont_miss: The resort's signature temazcal ceremony led by a local shaman, and dinner at Acre, the on-site restaurant helmed by a James Beard-nominated chef. The property also offers exclusive access to the nearby Cabo Pulmo coral reef, one of the oldest living reefs in North America and a UNESCO World Heritage site.
pros: Ultra-luxury Ritz-Carlton Reserve experience with unparalleled personalized service
Stunning oceanfront location on pristine Los Cabos coastline
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with holistic treatments
World-class dining venues featuring innovative Mexican cuisine
